nodes.label: The cell grows its biomass on the nutrient it consumes, with Monod-saturating...
nodes.statement: The cell grows its biomass on the nutrient it consumes, with Monod-saturating uptake feeding a yield-based growth step (MonodUptake + YieldGrowth). Growth rises with available nutrient but saturates rather than growing without bound, matching the intended Monod-limited phenotype. This confirms a bounded, goal-directed growth response driven by what the cell actually takes up.

CataboliteRepression — a Hill switch driven by glucose — gates LactoseUptake through a lac_repression store, and this repression coupling is what enforces the ordering.
